name: bar-chart
title: Bar Chart
description: A bar chart, vertical or horizontal, grouped or stacked, always measured from zero, with a tooltip on hover and arrow-key reading.

meta.when: Comparing amounts across categories. Use `orientation="horizontal"` for long names or a ranking, `stacked` when the series add up to a total. For change over many points in time use line-chart; for a single number use a stat, not one bar.
meta.example:
<BarChart
  label="Orders by channel per quarter"
  data={[
    { quarter: "Q1", web: 320, app: 210 },
    { quarter: "Q2", web: 410, app: 290 },
    { quarter: "Q3", web: 380, app: 350 },
  ]}
  x="quarter"
  series={[
    { key: "web", label: "Web" },
    { key: "app", label: "App" },
  ]}
  showValues
/>
